question: What regulation did the Supreme Court of India stay on January 29, 2026?
answer:

FINAL: УGC Equity Regulations, 2026

messages.content: [UGC Equity Regulations, 2026] The University Grants Commission (Promotion of Equity in Higher Education Institutions) Regulations, 2026, commonly referred to as the UGC Equity Regulations, 2026 or the Anti-Discrimination Rules, 2026, are regulations notified by the University Grants Commission (UGC) in India aimed at addressing discrimination within higher education institutions (HEIs). The regulations seek to replace the existing 2012 regulations with more stringent measures to ensure inclusion for students from marginalized backgrounds, particularly the Scheduled Castes (SC), Scheduled Tribes (ST) and Other Backward Classes (OBC). The bill saw protests against the Bharatiya Janta Party (BJP) across the country. As of 29 January 2026, the Supreme Court of India has stayed the proposed regulations.

На 29 января 2026 года Верховный суд Индии приостановил проект регулирования, известный как Регламенты UGC по обеспечению равенства в высших учебных заведениях, которые нацелены на борьбу с дискриминацией в образовании. 

FINAL: УGC Equity Regulations, 2026
